canonical_project: Manatua / Avaroa Cable Rarotonga landing station (Rutaki)
owner: Avaroa Cables Ltd (ACL), Cook Islands Investment Corporation (CIIC)
notes: Cable-landing asset (NOT a data centre per CK methodology): Manatua 3,600 km two-fiber-pair system ready for service 2020-07-22, brought ashore at Rutaki village, Rarotonga; landing station opened 2022. 10 Tb/s per fibre pair is connectivity capacity, not IT MW. Interconnection anchor for Rarotonga hosting (Vodafone Avarua/Aroa DCs, CIG colocation).
